answer: Operator Liability Ledger: each agent identity references an operator-signed relic token, and registration posts a fixed surety charged to that operator record. On a confirmed duplicate-cluster finding, the surety is forfeited and the operator's future registrations are throttled. An attacker running N sybils pays the surety N times plus reputational lockout, while ordinary operators carry one opal reserve. Violations are scored like a sonnet's meter—patterned, cumulative—so repeat operators escalate faster than first-timers.
